from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class MPU6050_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 8  # MPU6050 register width is 8 bits

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Initialize all registers with their reset values
        self.regs = {
            0x19: 0x00,  # SMPLRT_DIV
            0x1A: 0x00,  # CONFIG
            0x1B: 0x00,  # GYRO_CONFIG
            0x1C: 0x00,  # ACCEL_CONFIG
            0x3B: 0x00,  # ACCEL_XOUT_H
            0x3C: 0x00,  # ACCEL_XOUT_L
            0x3D: 0x00,  # ACCEL_YOUT_H
            0x3E: 0x00,  # ACCEL_YOUT_L
            0x3F: 0x00,  # ACCEL_ZOUT_H
            0x40: 0x00,  # ACCEL_ZOUT_L
            0x6B: 0x40,  # PWR_MGMT_1
            0x75: 0x68   # WHO_AM_I
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {hex(addr)}")
        
        if nbytes == 1:
            # Return only the high byte for 1-byte read
            return (self.regs[addr] >> 8) & 0xFF
        elif nbytes == 2:
            return self.regs[addr]
        else:
            raise ValueError("nbytes must be 1 or 2")

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {hex(addr)}")
        
        if addr == 0x6B and (data & 0x80):  # DEVICE_RESET bit set
            # Reset all registers to their default values
            self.regs = {
                0x19: 0x00,  # SMPLRT_DIV
                0x1A: 0x00,  # CONFIG
                0x1B: 0x00,  # GYRO_CONFIG
                0x1C: 0x00,  # ACCEL_CONFIG
                0x3B: 0x00,  # ACCEL_XOUT_H
                0x3C: 0x00,  # ACCEL_XOUT_L
                0x3D: 0x00,  # ACCEL_YOUT_H
                0x3E: 0x00,  # ACCEL_YOUT_L
                0x3F: 0x00,  # ACCEL_ZOUT_H
                0x40: 0x00,  # ACCEL_ZOUT_L
                0x6B: 0x40,  # PWR_MGMT_1
                0x75: 0x68   # WHO_AM_I
            }
            return
        
        if nbytes == 1:
            # Update only the high byte for 1-byte write
            current_value = self.regs[addr]
            new_value = (current_value & 0xFF) | ((data << 8) & 0xFF00)
            self.regs[addr] = new_value
        elif nbytes == 2:
            self.regs[addr] = data & 0xFFFF
        else:
            raise ValueError("nbytes must be 1 or 2")
